name: Alasdair Alan Ryder
note: Founder and chief executive of RSK Group. Companies House: his only active PSC entry is on Alan Ryder Investments Limited (75% or more of shares and voting rights), which is RSK Group Limited's only active person with significant control (more than 25% but not more than 50%). RSK received a £500m preferred equity investment from a consortium led by Searchlight Capital Partners and Ares Management in June 2024, plus an Ares debt facility (RSK's own announcement of 17 June 2024, rskgroup.com/news/rsk-welcomes-strategic-investment/, read via the Wayback Machine).
